papers.title: Mavacamten in Adolescents with Obstructive Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy.
papers.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Approved pharmacologic therapies for pediatric hypertrophic cardiomyopathy are lacking, and surgical intervention may be indicated in patients with left ventricular outflow tract obstruction. The efficacy and safety of mavacamten, a cardiac myosin inhibitor that is available for adults, warrant evaluation in adolescents. METHODS: Phase 3, double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial in adolescents (12-17 years) with obstructive HCM. RESULTS: Mavacamten significantly reduced LVOT gradient compared with placebo. Safety profile consistent with adult studies.
papers.summary_ja: 思春期（12〜17歳）の閉塞性肥大型心筋症に対するマバカメテンの初の Phase 3 RCT で、左室流出路圧較差の有意な改善が示され、小児 HCM に対する初の経口薬治療の可能性が開かれた。

papers.title: Base Editing of HBG1 and HBG2 Promoters for Sickle Cell Disease.
papers.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
papers.type: Phase 1-2 非ランダム化単群試験
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Sickle cell disease is characterized by chronic hemolytic anemia and recurrent severe vaso-occlusive crises. Ristoglogene autogetemcel (risto-cel) includes autologous CD34+ hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells that have been base-edited to target the HBG1 and HBG2 promoters. METHODS: Phase 1-2 study, patients 12 to 35 years of age with SCD, at least 4 VOC/year. RESULTS: HbF increased substantially (>30%) and VOC essentially eliminated. No serious off-target mutations.
papers.summary_ja: 塩基編集技術（risto-cel）による HBG1/HBG2 プロモーター標的化が鎌状赤血球症患者の HbF を 30% 超に持続的に上昇させ、重篤な血管閉塞危機をほぼ消失させた。

papers.title: CRISPR-Cas12a Gene Editing of HBG1 and HBG2 Promoters to Treat Sickle Cell Disease.
papers.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Renizgamglogene autogedtemcel (reni-cel) is an investigational CRISPR-Cas12a gene-edited autologous hematopoietic stem-cell therapy targeting BCL11A binding sites in HBG1 and HBG2 promoters to reactivate fetal hemoglobin. METHODS: Phase 1-2, multicenter, open-label, single-group study involving patients with severe sickle cell disease. RESULTS: HbF levels exceeded 40% in all patients and were sustained. Major VOC effectively eliminated. Safety profile similar to standard SCT.
papers.summary_ja: CRISPR-Cas12a を使った reni-cel が重篤な鎌状赤血球症患者において HbF を 40% 超に持続的に上昇させ、VOC をほぼ完全に消失させた多施設 Phase 1-2 試験。

papers.title: Progress towards the WHO Global Initiative for Childhood Cancer target of 60% 5-year survival for all childhood cancers by 2030.
papers.type: 人口ベース世界監視研究（CONCORD-4）
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: CONCORD-4 included all childhood cancers for the first time. The WHO GICC set a target of 60% 5-year survival for all childhood cancers by 2030. METHODS: Population-based cancer survival data from 50+ countries, children aged 0-14, diagnosed 2000-2014. RESULTS: High-income countries achieve 80-90% for leukemia/lymphoma. Low/middle-income countries remain 40-50%. Brain tumors show slowest improvement globally. Current trends suggest many LMIC will not achieve the 60% target by 2030.
papers.summary_ja: CONCORD-4 が世界 50 カ国以上の小児がん生存率を初めて包括分析し、高所得国は白血病・リンパ腫で目標達成済みも低中所得国は 40〜50% に留まり、2030 年 WHO 60% 目標の達成が困難であることを示した。

papers.title: Cognitive and Educational Outcomes After Preterm Birth or Low Birth Weight: An Umbrella Review and Meta-Analysis.
papers.type: アンブレラレビュー・メタ解析
papers.abstract: IMPORTANCE: Advances in perinatal care have improved survival for preterm or low birth weight infants, but these individuals remain at increased risk of poorer cognitive and educational outcomes. OBJECTIVE: To synthesize evidence from systematic reviews on cognitive and educational outcomes after preterm birth or low birth weight. RESULTS: Preterm birth is associated with IQ 7-10 points lower than term controls, substantially higher rates of special education. Dose-response relationship with gestational age. Early intervention shows limited evidence for long-term benefit.
papers.summary_ja: 早産・低出生体重児は正期産対照と比較して IQ が平均 7〜10 点低く、特別支援教育参加率が著明に高いことを系統的レビューのメタ解析で確認し、在胎週数との用量反応関係を示した。

papers.title: CRISPR-Cas12a Gene Editing of HBG1 and HBG2 Promoters to Treat β-Thalassemia.
papers.journal: The New England Journal of Medicine
papers.abstract: Phase 1-2 multicenter study of reni-cel in patients 18 to 35 years with severe beta-thalassemia requiring regular red-cell transfusions. Results showed substantial HbF elevation and transfusion independence in the majority of participants.
papers.summary_ja: CRISPR-Cas12a（reni-cel）が重症 β サラセミア患者において HbF を大幅に上昇させ、定期輸血からの独立を達成した多施設 Phase 1-2 試験。

papers.title: Initial Resuscitation of Preterm Infants With Targeted Oxygen.
papers.abstract: Evaluation of targeted oxygen approach in initial resuscitation of preterm infants in delivery room.
papers.summary_ja: 早産児の分娩室初期蘇生における目標酸素飽和度管理（targeted oxygen）戦略の有効性を評価した JAMA 掲載研究。

papers.title: Peer support intervention (ABA-feed) to improve breastfeeding: UK based, multicentre, parallel group, randomised controlled trial.
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVE: To assess the effect of a proactive, assets-based, peer support infant feeding intervention (ABA-feed) in addition to usual care on breastfeeding rates. DESIGN: UK based, multicentre, unblinded, RCT across 17 localities. RESULTS: ABA-feed improved overall breastfeeding and feeding practices compared with usual care.
papers.summary_ja: 積極的なアセット型ピアサポート授乳支援（ABA-feed）を通常ケアに付加した多施設 RCT で、英国 17 地域において母乳育児率と授乳行動の改善が示された。

papers.title: Fast MRI Compared With Head CT in Evaluating Pediatric Neurologic Emergencies.
papers.type: 前向き比較研究（計画的サブ解析）
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES: To compare outcomes of patients receiving limited-sequence brain MRI (fast MRI) versus head CT in the emergency department. METHODS: Planned subanalysis of a prospective study. RESULTS: Fast MRI had less missed pathology while not significantly increasing length of stay compared with head CT.
papers.summary_ja: 小児救急での限定シーケンス fast MRI は head CT と比較して見逃し病変が少なく在室時間も延長しなかったことから、放射線被曝回避の代替として有望と示された前向き比較研究。

papers.title: Prediction of Developmental Outcomes in Preterm Infants: A Systematic Review.
papers.abstract: CONTEXT: Increased survival of very preterm children raises concerns about later outcomes. OBJECTIVE: Summarize prediction models for developmental outcomes after very preterm birth. RESULTS: Current prediction models have limited predictive accuracy and generalizability. Clinical use should be tempered with appropriate uncertainty.
papers.summary_ja: 超早産児の発達予後予測モデルを系統的にレビューし、既存モデルの精度・一般化可能性の限界を明らかにした。NICU 退院前カウンセリングでの予後予測の不確実性を保護者と共有することの重要性を論じた。

papers.title: Parent-Reported Chronic Pain in Children With and Without Developmental Disabilities.
papers.type: 横断研究（大規模国民調査）
papers.abstract: IMPORTANCE: Prevalence of chronic pain in children with developmental disabilities is unclear. OBJECTIVE: Evaluate parent-reported chronic pain prevalence and association between developmental disabilities and chronic pain in US children. RESULTS: Children with developmental disabilities had 2-3 times higher prevalence of parent-reported chronic pain compared to children without developmental disabilities.
papers.summary_ja: 米国 NSCH 大規模横断研究で、発達障害（ASD・ADHD・知的障害等）を持つ小児は慢性疼痛の保護者報告頻度が 2〜3 倍高く、コミュニケーション困難な患者での疼痛評価の重要性が示された。

papers.title: Vitamin K Deficiency Bleeding After Refusal: A Sentinel Event in a Misinformation Era.
papers.abstract: Report of neonatal vitamin K deficiency bleeding following parental refusal of vitamin K administration. Discussion of misinformation and social media influence on parental decision-making.
papers.summary_ja: ビタミン K 投与拒否後に発症した新生児 VKDB を「誤情報時代の警鐘」として報告し、SNS 上の反ビタミン K ムーブメントが医療忌避に与える影響と適切なコミュニケーション戦略の必要性を論じた。
papers.domain_name: 小児特有の横断的テーマ

papers.title: Is young people's mental health worse than in the past?
papers.type: 論評・エビデンス統合
papers.abstract: Analysis of trends in young people's mental health, examining whether mental health is genuinely worsening or whether changes reflect improved detection, altered help-seeking behavior, and shifting diagnostic thresholds.
papers.summary_ja: 若者のメンタルヘルスが「本当に悪化しているのか」というエビデンスを BMJ が精査し、一部指標は悪化も検出感度・受診行動・診断閾値変化との鑑別が複雑であることを解説した論評。

papers.title: Immune Thrombocytopenia in Children.
papers.abstract: Immune thrombocytopenia (ITP) is one of the most common acquired bleeding disorders in children. Management is guided by severity of symptoms rather than platelet count alone. Thrombopoietin receptor agonists (eltrombopag, romiplostim) are available for chronic/refractory cases.
papers.summary_ja: 小児 ITP の病態・分類・管理の最新レビュー。血小板数のみではなく出血症状重症度に基づく治療アルゴリズムと、慢性・難治例への TPO-RA（eltrombopag, romiplostim）の位置づけを整理した。

papers.title: Measles: 38 children dead in Bangladesh outbreak.
papers.abstract: Bangladesh measles outbreak resulting in 38 child deaths. Attributed to declining vaccination rates and cold chain issues.
papers.summary_ja: バングラデシュで麻疹アウトブレイクが発生し小児 38 人が死亡。ワクチン接種率低下・コールドチェーン問題が背景にあり、世界的麻疹再興の継続を示す速報。
